OFF/BEAT

Your brand has a logo. What does it sound like? Make a sound logo for any brand, then turn a failed startup into a beat, solve the daily rhythm, or test whether you can stay off the beat.

Brand sound

Type a brand name, pick a vibe, and hear three sound logos. Every letter becomes a note, vowels become chords, and the accents land off the beat. The same name and vibe always give the same three.

Remix chain

On the beat Off the beat
22% Pushes every off-beat a little late. Watch the white cells slide lower as it grows.
60% More bass weight. Phone speakers can't play the lowest notes, so extra harmonics are added to let you hear the bass there. Headphones or a speaker give the full low end.

Drums

Melody

Tap two notes in one column to play a chord. All layers play together, and every note is from one scale, so nothing clashes.

Song

Turn your Studio pattern into an 8-bar song with real instruments. The arranger picks the key, the chords, the instruments and how the song builds, then re-harmonises your notes to each chord. Make a beat in the Studio first, or just press Arrange.

Connect your own AI (optional)

The arranger above is rule-based and works offline. To let a real AI model choose the key, chords, instruments and structure, deploy the small proxy in ai-worker.js (it keeps your API key off this page), then paste its address here. It is saved only in this browser.

Your failure, as a beat

Every startup that ended taught something. Tell me about yours and get a sound plus a card to share. It always ends on a bright off-beat chord, the comeback. Nothing is uploaded.

How it ended

Daily Off-Beat

Listen to today's one-bar rhythm, then rebuild it. After each guess you see how many of the 8 steps are right. Six guesses, and everyone gets the same puzzle today.


        
      

    

  


  

    

      
Can you stay off the beat?

      

      
A metronome clicks. After four clicks to get ready, tap in the gaps between the clicks, sixteen times. Most people drift back onto the beat. Use headphones, since Bluetooth adds delay.

      

        
        
        
      

      

        
Ready when you are

        
        

      

      

        

        

        

        

        
Each column is one tap. Up is early, down is late, a hollow ring is a miss.
